messages.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

### 已知事實
- Automotive radar echo-generation coverage includes `24 GHz to 24.25 GHz`, `76 GHz to 81 GHz`, and `24 GHz to 44 GHz` frontend bands, depending on the frontend used [47].  
- R&S ZNA base VNA models cover up to `67 GHz`, while R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system covering `10 MHz to 110 GHz` [6][17].  
- R&S QAT100 with AREG800A supports `76 GHz to 77 GHz` and `77 GHz to 81 GHz` RF ranges with `4 GHz` RF instantaneous bandwidth [43].  
- AREG800A production configurations include `5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth`, and the AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth can be `1 GHz`, `2 GHz`, or `5 GHz` depending on option [44][47].  
- AREG800A RF transfer characteristics are measured with a vector network analyzer using `2.5 MHz` frequency step size and `1 kHz` measurement bandwidth, with amplitude flatness and group delay flatness specified across `1 GHz`, `2 GHz`, and `4 GHz` bandwidths [42].  
- Suppression of ghost objects is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain, using `125 kHz` frequency step size, `100 kHz` measurement bandwidth, `–10 dBm` source power, and spans up to `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` depending on bandwidth [10].  
- AREG800A IF transfer / dynamic RCS measurements use vector network analyzer conditions of `2.5 MHz` frequency step size, `1 kHz` measurement bandwidth, `–10 dBm` source power, and spans including `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`, `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`, and `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` [11].  
- R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is `1 Hz to 1.5 MHz` in the base unit and `1 Hz to 30 MHz` with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [9].  
- R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range `> 129 dB` without options, `147 dB` typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to `170 dB` allowing full 2-port correction [5].  
### 對 VNA 量測能力的影響
【推論】When automotive radar work involves `76 GHz to 81 GHz` radar bands, a VNA limited to `67 GHz` is not sufficient for direct full-band RF characterization, so the required VNA capability shifts toward mmWave coverage such as a `10 MHz to 110 GHz` VNA system [47][6][17].  
【推論】When automotive radar bandwidth expands to `4 GHz` RF instantaneous bandwidth or `5 GHz` instantaneous IF bandwidth, the VNA measurement need shifts toward wide-span characterization of amplitude flatness and group delay flatness over GHz-class bandwidths, using measurement setups such as `2.5 MHz` frequency steps and `1 kHz` measurement bandwidth [43][44][42].  
【推論】When radar testing emphasizes artificial objects, RCS behavior, Doppler/echo quality, and ghost-object suppression, the VNA must support time-domain measurement, fine frequency stepping, low-noise / high-dynamic-range measurements, and controlled bandwidth settings such as `125 kHz` step size, `100 kHz` measurement bandwidth, and up to `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` spans [10][11][5][9].

- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S ZNA]] — Vector Network Analyzer 系列，涵蓋 26.5 GHz、43.5 GHz、50 GHz、67 GHz 型號。
- [[R&S ZNA26]] — 26.5 GHz 型號，3.5 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA43]] — 43.5 GHz 型號，2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA50]] — 50 GHz 型號，2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA67]] — 67 GHz 型號，1.85 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[Vector Network Analyzer]]、[[Dynamic range]]、[[Measurement bandwidth]]、[[Direct source and receiver access]]、[[Noise figure measurement]]、[[mmWave converter support]]、[[Phase-coherent source control]]、[[Health and utilization monitoring service]]、[[Time domain analysis]]、[[Deembedding]]。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。

- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

R&S ZNA

### 已知事實
- Automotive radar echo-generation coverage includes `24 GHz to 24.25 GHz`, `76 GHz to 81 GHz`, and `24 GHz to 44 GHz` frontend bands, depending on the frontend used [47].  
- R&S ZNA base VNA models cover up to `67 GHz`, while R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system covering `10 MHz to 110 GHz` [6][17].  
- R&S QAT100 with AREG800A supports `76 GHz to 77 GHz` and `77 GHz to 81 GHz` RF ranges with `4 GHz` RF instantaneous bandwidth [43].  
- AREG800A production configurations include `5 GHz instantaneous bandwidth`, and the AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth can be `1 GHz`, `2 GHz`, or `5 GHz` depending on option [44][47].  
- AREG800A RF transfer characteristics are measured with a vector network analyzer using `2.5 MHz` frequency step size and `1 kHz` measurement bandwidth, with amplitude flatness and group delay flatness specified across `1 GHz`, `2 GHz`, and `4 GHz` bandwidths [42].  
- Suppression of ghost objects is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain, using `125 kHz` frequency step size, `100 kHz` measurement bandwidth, `–10 dBm` source power, and spans up to `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` depending on bandwidth [10].  
- AREG800A IF transfer / dynamic RCS measurements use vector network analyzer conditions of `2.5 MHz` frequency step size, `1 kHz` measurement bandwidth, `–10 dBm` source power, and spans including `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`, `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`, and `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` [11].  
- R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is `1 Hz to 1.5 MHz` in the base unit and `1 Hz to 30 MHz` with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [9].  
- R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range `> 129 dB` without options, `147 dB` typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to `170 dB` allowing full 2-port correction [5].  
### 對 VNA 量測能力的影響
【推論】When automotive radar work involves `76 GHz to 81 GHz` radar bands, a VNA limited to `67 GHz` is not sufficient for direct full-band RF characterization, so the required VNA capability shifts toward mmWave coverage such as a `10 MHz to 110 GHz` VNA system [47][6][17].  
【推論】When automotive radar bandwidth expands to `4 GHz` RF instantaneous bandwidth or `5 GHz` instantaneous IF bandwidth, the VNA measurement need shifts toward wide-span characterization of amplitude flatness and group delay flatness over GHz-class bandwidths, using measurement setups such as `2.5 MHz` frequency steps and `1 kHz` measurement bandwidth [43][44][42].  
【推論】When radar testing emphasizes artificial objects, RCS behavior, Doppler/echo quality, and ghost-object suppression, the VNA must support time-domain measurement, fine frequency stepping, low-noise / high-dynamic-range measurements, and controlled bandwidth settings such as `125 kHz` step size, `100 kHz` measurement bandwidth, and up to `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` spans [10][11][5][9].
